configuration.approved_by: repository owner directive: 'Do it all' (complete the remediation plan)
configuration.scope: requirement revisions only; no target threshold was loosened and no measurement was promoted to a claim

revisions.original_claim: The per-call TTT budget is enforced in recall() and measured per path.
revisions.revised_requirement: Every plastic path (recall, approve, reject, correct) consumes the same step and rate budget through one gate, and exhaustion is reported.
revisions.rationale: The historical wording named recall() only; the implementation centralised the budget, so evidence now cites the single gate rather than one call site.

revisions.original_claim: Forgetting is measured as the fraction of facts outside a rolling usage window.
revisions.revised_requirement: Availability decays as a power law of elapsed time and access count; the forgetting-rate metric counts facts whose decayed accessibility is below the documented threshold.
revisions.rationale: The rolling-window fraction was replaced by a decayed accessibility score; the historical task cannot be satisfied as written.

revisions.original_claim: retrieval_quality is a placeholder 0.5 value in the health payload.
revisions.revised_requirement: precision@k and MRR are computed from persisted labelled feedback and report None with an explicit reason when there are no judgements.
revisions.rationale: A constant is not a measurement; the metric now depends on labelled data and the insufficient-evidence case is explicit.

revisions.original_claim: Hidden-state injection is required of the GGUF backend.
revisions.revised_requirement: Hidden injection is offered only for a hookable PyTorch decoder; a GGUF binding must report the capability unsupported and never fake it.
revisions.rationale: A llama.cpp binding exposes no residual-stream hook, so the historical requirement could only be met by fabricating success.

revisions.original_claim: KV priming succeeds for any configured backend.
revisions.revised_requirement: KV priming is a declared backend capability: unsupported bindings fail explicitly, and a priming call that cannot prove cache consumption is an error.
revisions.rationale: Metadata-only success hid a no-op; the capability contract makes the limit visible.

outcome_meaning: approved = each superseded historical claim names a replacement requirement that the main specs carry and that has its own passing evidence.
